title: Network sharing
description: Other computers at home running Bookeeper can connect to this library while this computer is on.
toggle: Share this library on the network
phones: Phones do not connect from here: they need a secure address, see Devices.

password.title: Set a password first
password.text: To open the library to the network its owner must have a password.

errors.portNotAllowed: Port {port} is reserved by the system. Pick one from 1024 up and try again.
errors.bindFailed: Could not open port {port}. Pick another port and try again.
errors.tls: Could not prepare the security certificate. Sharing is off.
errors.mdns: Sharing works, but this computer is not visible to others: on the other computers type the address by hand.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port can only be changed while sharing is off.
port.label: Port number
port.error: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

reach.title: How to reach this computer
reach.description: These are the addresses of this library on your home network.

phrase.title: Verification phrase
phrase.label: Verification phrase: {phrase}
phrase.explain: Whoever connects will see the same six words. Check that they match: if they differ, do not continue.

how.title: Connect another computer
how.step1: On the other computer open Bookeeper and choose to connect to a library.
how.step2: On this computer go to Devices and press “{add}” to get a code.
how.step3: On the other computer pick this library, check the verification phrase and enter the code.
